item.text:
Three modules directly use `config.Settings`:

- [`src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py:19`](<work>/anvil-graph/src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py:19) loads settings to configure the logging level and include the application environment in the startup log.
- [`src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:379`](<work>/anvil-graph/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:379) loads NVIDIA/Ollama endpoint URLs and the NVIDIA API key. It validates that the key exists when NVIDIA is selected, constructs provider endpoints, and uses the Ollama URL to retrieve version/model metadata.
- [`tests/test_smoke.py:12`](<work>/anvil-graph/tests/test_smoke.py:12) tests configuration defaults with dotenv loading disabled: environment `dev`, logging `INFO`, and data directory `data`.

[`src/nvidia_ai/config.py:26`](<work>/anvil-graph/src/nvidia_ai/config.py:26) defines the frozen `Settings` dataclass and its environment/optional `.env` loader.
